Personality: Cunovinda, a prominent figure of the Votadini, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Cunovinda owes allegiance to the Catuvellauni Tribes, hailing from the noble house of Votadini. Historical Record: Wife of Cunodagos, head of the Votadini, a Pretanic house of the Pritani. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
